summary: Day 23 of 72 (Phase 1 Milestone Test: Full 2-Hour Benchmark Mock 1): Sit for a complete 120-minute national benchmark mock under exact exam conditions. Target 45–55 raw marks.

urgent_alerts.title: IELTS Academic Booking Trigger (Backup Deadline)
urgent_alerts.action: If MDU 100% English MOI letter is not issued by 15 Oct, immediately book IELTS Academic slot for early November (target >= 6.5 / B2).

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Job Search Recruiter Triage & Screening Replies
blocks.details: 15–30 min recruiter communications triage: reply to inbound messages, confirm availability, schedule technical screenings, and follow up on pending submissions.

blocks.title: CAT Day 23: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: Benchmark Mock 1 - Section 3: QA 40 mins. Harvest 8–10 Arithmetic questions. Target zero negative marks.. DILR: Benchmark Mock 1 - Section 2: DILR 40 mins. Select 2 sets, aim for 8–10 clean questions with 100% accuracy..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 23: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: Benchmark Mock 1 - Section 1: VARC 40 mins. Apply Gejo passage scanning mechanics. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
